description: This source file implements a tracing/event recording module for a Git-related project, handling various event types, formatting JSON data, and interfacing with a tracing destination.

classes.name: tr2_dst
classes.description: A structure representing the tracing destination, used for outputting event data.

classes.name: json_writer
classes.description: A utility structure for constructing JSON objects for event records.

methods.name: int fn_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the event target, configuring nesting levels and brief mode based on environment variables.

methods.name: void fn_term(void)
methods.description: Terminates the event target, disabling the tracing destination.

methods.name: void event_fmt_prepare(const char * event_name,const char * file,int line,const struct repository * repo,struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Prepares a JSON object with common event fields such as event name, session ID, thread, timestamp, file, line, and repository ID.

methods.name: void fn_too_many_files_fl(const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Emits an event indicating too many files were encountered.

methods.name: void fn_version_fl(const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Emits a version event with version info about the JSON data format and executable version.

methods.name: void fn_start_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Emits a start event with elapsed time and command-line arguments.

methods.name: void fn_exit_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int code)
methods.description: Emits an exit event with elapsed time and exit code.

methods.name: void fn_signal(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int signo)
methods.description: Emits a signal event with elapsed time and signal number.

methods.name: void fn_atexit(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int code)
methods.description: Emits an atexit event with elapsed time and exit code.

methods.name: void fn_error_va_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Emits an error event with a formatted message.

methods.description: Emits an event with command name and hierarchy.

methods.name: void fn_command_mode_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * mode)
methods.description: Emits an event with command mode information.

methods.name: void fn_alias_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * alias,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Emits an alias event with alias and arguments.
